final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Collegi, luoghi di ricovero, case di pena, caserme, conventi',
    'Ospedali, cliniche, case di cura e assimilabili'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 600
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 75
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the property located near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics) for a residential senior care facility. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06, rounded to 75).

typologies: Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area. The 30-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to healthcare services are not reference columns and are not filtered here.

The user wants energy class D or better, so the filter includes A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C and D. The user's other requirements (gross floor area of at least 1600 sqm, capacity for 30 people, proximity to healthcare services, Turin location) are not energy-efficiency columns and are not handled here.

output.explanation: Filters hotel-type buildings (property_type) with surface_area >= 1600, energy_class from A1 to D, healthcare score >= 75, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the center point, nearest first. The capacity of 30 people is not an extracted requirement, so it is not applied.
